# CitedBy

> CitedBy checks whether ChatGPT names an online shop when a buyer asks about its category, then fixes what keeps the shop out of the answer. Service for EU online shops, run from Spain. Free mini-audit; Fix Pack €390 paid once; CitedBy Monthly €149 per month.

## Pages
- [Home, prices and guarantees](https://citedby.eu/): what we do, prices, FAQ
- [Free check](https://citedby.eu/check): enter a shop URL, get a ChatGPT answer check (also /fr/check, /nl/check)
- [Sample audit](https://citedby.eu/sample-audit): a full anonymised audit with all 16 raw answers
- [Study](https://citedby.eu/data/study-chatgpt-buyer-questions): 127 ChatGPT answers to 64 buyer questions in 5 EU niches, 13 and 14 Oct 2026, with method and CSV
- [Data by niche](https://citedby.eu/data): who ChatGPT linked, question by question
